invariants.title: Her side on the left, his on the right
invariants.rule: Terra and the esper are on the LEFT of the screen, the jester on the RIGHT, for the whole shot.
invariants.why: one line of action for the film: every camera stands east of the line between them

invariants.title: Facing
invariants.rule: Terra faces screen-right (toward him); the jester faces screen-left (toward her), as the set's frames draw them.
invariants.why: a take keeps the facing its two frames give it; the duel's were mirrored by a bug

invariants.title: Its leg of the relay: breath
invariants.rule: A cutaway while time passes - story time 0 to 4 s.
invariants.why: LTX_PLAYBOOK §101: every shot is a leg of one moment; an echo repeats time already told

invariants.title: What holds its cut
invariants.rule: L-cut: the wind and his laugh run on under 020.
invariants.why: LTX_PLAYBOOK §102 (draft): something overlaps the cut so the next shot does not start fresh

invariants.title: He is winning
invariants.rule: He juggles, laughing; she is the one who steps BACK.

invariants.title: Length
invariants.why: each leg's length is its share of the story time

flair.title: Seed
flair.note: free - the takes differ by seed

flair.title: Timing inside the shot
flair.note: the beats may land a few frames early or late

flair.title: How far the place has burned
flair.note: the dress for this shot: dusk (dusk, red, burning, volcanic - it only ever gets worse)

flair.title: Sound
flair.note: H3's own: wind, his giggle, the hum of the orbs.

title: losing
beat: Where we are: he is winning, she is hurt. [breath · story t 0-4 s · glue: L-cut: the wind and his laugh run on under 020] (shot 1 of 23)
build: frames first in the clearing set (set_test.py render + cast --ends), H3 between the set's two frames (set_film.py takes) - the camera, the marks and the facing come from the set; the place's state from the shot's dress
